recipe.title: white bean spread
recipe.description: Growing up, my mom packed my school lunch every single day. From the first grade to my first year in…
ingredients: 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed
a bit of water, if necessary to thin
optional: toss in some herbs: rosemary for winter, basil for spring, etc
instructions: Puree all ingredients in a food processor or blender. Taste and adjust seasonings. Slather on bread & serve with sandwich fixings of your choice. Mine (pictured), is avocado, arugula & hemp seeds.
